description: Strap in! We are THE ZENITH CREW - three Artemis and one Apollo aiming for the highest point in the sky! Presenting Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, an interactive game where YOU become a NASA astronaut. Can YOU conquer Space Fitness, survive harsh Mars conditions, and manage vital oxygen, food & water? Experience how microgravity transforms your body! With immersive animations & super-fun gameplay, we turned training into an epic adventure.
